title: An etale algebra over a finite polynomial algebra is standard smooth
statement: Let $R$ and $B$ be commutative rings with an $R$-algebra structure, $n\ge0$, and let $\theta:R[z_1,\ldots,z_n]\to B$ be an $R$-algebra homomorphism [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. If $B$ is etale over $R[z_1,\ldots,z_n]$ through $\theta$ in the ring-map sense of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-ring-map-iff-etale-affine], then $B$ is standard smooth over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-standard-smooth-algebra].

source.place: Final paragraph of Lemma 07CH; Algebra Lemma 00U9; Mathlib Smooth/StandardSmoothOfFree.lean:50,90 and Smooth/StandardSmooth.lean:138; source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CH

proof.text: Give B its polynomial-algebra structure through theta. The R-algebra homomorphism property supplies the scalar tower. Mathlib Algebra.Etale.iff_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_zero makes this algebra standard smooth of relative dimension zero, hence standard smooth.

The polynomial differential basis consists of D(X_i). Apply Mathlib Algebra.IsStandardSmooth.of_basis_kaehlerDifferential to that basis; finite presentation and vanishing H1 are the polynomial instances. Thus the finite polynomial algebra is standard smooth over R.
Compose the two standard smooth algebras with Mathlib Algebra.IsStandardSmooth.trans. This is the concatenation of the submersive presentations, using the scalar tower supplied by theta.
